description: The six full-GUI directions: one choice per component family (controls.json). 'original' keeps the production drawing for that family.

01-original-refined.label: 01 Original Refined
01-original-refined.summary: The current GUI and approved knob; real slabs, contact shadows and bezels, hybrid flat buttons, refined flat tabs, the current volume slider.

02-warm-ceramic.label: 02 Warm Ceramic
02-warm-ceramic.summary: Satin ceramic cards and macro panel, soft ivory buttons, ivory fader cap in a minimal groove, refined flat tabs.

03-brushed-ivory.label: 03 Brushed Ivory
03-brushed-ivory.summary: Brushed ivory housing, cards and macro panel; soft physical buttons; ivory precision fader in a recessed slot; minimal tabs.

04-warm-aluminum.label: 04 Warm Aluminium
04-warm-aluminum.summary: A brushed champagne-metal macro plate with a fine seam, precision metal buttons, a brushed aluminium fader on a metal guide; ivory knobs.

05-graphite-contrast.label: 05 Graphite Contrast
05-graphite-contrast.summary: Warm ivory enclosure, the six macros in a graphite inset, inset buttons with graphite grooves, graphite keybed, a graphite fader in a recessed slot.

06-hybrid-premium.label: 06 Hybrid Premium
06-hybrid-premium.summary: Warm ivory housing, a subtly recessed satin macro section, precision inset buttons, refined flat tabs, a brushed aluminium cap in a recessed slot, lens LEDs and a recessed divider.

09-warm-ceramic-teak.label: 09 Warm Ceramic + Teak
09-warm-ceramic-teak.summary: Your round-2 pick: Warm Ceramic with oiled teak cheeks, the C1 ivory fader on the T3 metal guide, rendered lens LEDs (macros and ARP), the painted divider; layer-knob names lifted and the MACROS title removed (plugin changes).

10-celadon-teak.label: 10 Celadon & Teak
10-celadon-teak.summary: Round 2, Braun-inspired: cool satin off-white panel, pale celadon keys (grouped keys in a black recessed bank), a celadon fader in a recessed slot, teak cheeks; approved ivory knobs.

11-studio-keys.label: 11 Studio Keys
11-studio-keys.summary: Round 2: Warm Ceramic + teak with the second reference's controls: cream keycaps in dark wells and cream cylindrical knobs on every knob (macros included).

12-studio-keys-approved-macros.label: 12 Studio Keys, approved macro knob
12-studio-keys-approved-macros.summary: Round 2: as 11, but the six macros keep the approved Blender knob; the layer and ADSR knobs get the cream caps.
